title: Here’s Where to Watch ‘Oasis: Don’t Look Back in Anger’ Online
summary: The music documentary drops on Friday, October 9 — watch online for free.
contentText:

After 16 years apart, Bitpop band Oasis came back together for one of the biggest world tours of 2025. Throughout the tour, directors Dylan Southern and Will Lovelace filmed just about everything with complete access to the band, as well as to previously feuding brothers Liam and Noel Gallagher.

Watch on Disney+

And after the new documentary premiered at the Venice Film Festival and a brief theatrical run in movie theaters around the world earlier this year, the concert film Oasis: Don’t Look Back in Anger makes its streaming debut this weekend.

Starting Friday (Oct. 9) at 3 a.m. ET/midnight PT, Oasis: Don’t Look Back in Anger is available to stream on Disney+ .

How to Watch ‘Oasis: Don’t Look Back in Anger’ Online for Free

'Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger'

Get Disney+

Get Disney+ and Hulu plans starting at $12.99 per month.

Disney+ plans start at $12.49 per month for the ad-supported plan, while you can go ad-free for $21.49 per month. For even more content, Disney+ offers a bundle with Hulu, which starts at $12.99 per month (just 50 cents more to add Hulu). You can add ESPN Unlimited to Disney+ and Hulu starting at $35.99 per month.

Meanwhile, if you’re not into ESPN Unlimited, you can add HBO Max to Disney+ and Hulu instead with prices starting at $21.99 per month.

Hulu + Live TV

Get Hulu + Live TV 3-day free Trial

Get your first month of service for just $49.99.

If you don’t have a  Hulu + Live TV subscription, the streamer offers a  three-day free trial  that’ll get you your first three days free to access Oasis: Don’t Look Back in Anger on Disney+, as well as more than 100 other channels. Once the free trial is over, you’ll be charged the regular subscription fee, which is on sale for $49.99 for the first month ($99.99 per month afterward). It even comes with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited at no extra cost to watch even more exclusive and original sporting events and programming.
